title: agentic-sdlc track file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter contract for _/tracks/<TICKET>.md. Every cycle command reads and writes this frontmatter — the body of the markdown file is for humans.

ticket.description: Ticket identifier or freeform slug when ticketing.system is 'none'.

size.description: Ticket size tier, proposed at intake and confirmed by the user. 's' (small/XS) skips e2e + demo and the 3-agent review — the project's quality-gate pipeline rerun is the sole verification. 'm' (default) runs the full cycle. 'l' is a mother track that splits into one sub-track per AC group (see parent/children). Absent ⇒ 'm', so pre-existing tracks stay valid. Downgrading a track to 's' always needs explicit user confirmation, even under --auto.

parent.description: For an 'l' sub-track: the ticket id of its mother track. null for standalone and mother tracks.

children.description: For an 'l' mother track: the ticket ids of its sub-tracks (one per AC group). null for standalone and sub-tracks.

branch.description: Set by /agentic-sdlc:implement when the branch is created.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the spec slice captured at intake; /agentic-sdlc:revalidate uses it to detect drift.

rows.description: Row range when the ticket references a sub-section, e.g. '131-132'.

applicable.description: False when the feature has no UI surface; /agentic-sdlc:validate writes a 'na' report and skips recording.

evidence.description: file:line reference or commit SHA recording where the requirement landed.

phase_log.description: One entry per cycle phase that ran. Append-only; /agentic-sdlc:cycle and individual commands both write here.
